add_copresence.gloss: two distinct items remain side by side in the same scene without becoming one thing

compose_sequence.gloss: the outcome of one pass becomes the starting condition for the next pass
compose_sequence.plain: one result becomes the next starting point

divide_ratio.gloss: one share is compared against another so the relation between them becomes the point

multiply_integrate.gloss: separate pieces are bound into one functioning whole while their roles remain inside it

subtract_remove.gloss: one item is taken out so the remaining situation changes around its absence
